description: Source code for the PageViewStream object, which analyzes streaming web page view data using Apache Spark Streaming. It demonstrates various streaming operations such as counting, windowed counts, error rate calculations, and joining with external datasets.

classes.name: PageViewStream
classes.description: Main object that sets up and runs the Spark Streaming job for analyzing web page views.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the streaming analysis, processes command-line arguments, sets up streaming context, defines streaming computations, and starts the streaming job.
